displayTitle: A-Wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model
synopsis: Star Wars: A-Wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model is an activity book that as released as part of the Journey to Star Wars: The Last JediBuild your own A-wing with this IncrediBuilds: Star Wars model kit, featuring a full-color book with facts and trivia on this incredible spacecraft.Build and color your own 3D A-wing model and learn all about this Star Wars starfighter in this deluxe IncrediBuilds book set.The iconic A-wing Interceptor is yours to build and personalize with this exciting Star Wars wood model set. The deluxe 32-page hardcover book is packed with information on A-wing - from basic capabilities to its pivotal role in both the Rebel Alliance and the Resistance - and is filled with stunning imagery and behind-the-scenes content from the Star Wars universe. The wood model is easy to assemble and snaps together to form a dynamic, displayable 3D version of the A-wing that fans will love
title: A-Wing Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model
